title: September 2026 AVAX failed ~$8 breakout (founding process regression)
purpose: Draft registry pointer to the permanent dogfood case: failed breakout near $8, subsequent decline, and the rule that relief bounces must not reset a bearish higher-timeframe regime after structural invalidation. This entry does not invent prices, timestamps beyond the existing fixture range, forecast scores, or outcomes.

time_range.note: Copied from the existing RLH fixture manifest as_of_range. Exact candle timestamps and prices live in that fixture tree. This draft does not seal the window or add outcomes.

horizons.note: This gate is state-discipline and process invariants, not a next-10-candle scoreboard.

metrics.name: parent_regime_after_failed_breakout
metrics.description: Process invariant name from the RLH fixture. Not a forecast score.

metrics.name: relief_bounce_is_not_reversal
metrics.description: 5m/15m bounces remain relief inside the parent bear unless explicit reclaim rules fire.

metrics.name: invalidation_immutable
metrics.description: Invalidation must not move lower to preserve a prior bull thesis after it has fired.

metrics.name: challenge_required
metrics.description: Directional synthesis must include a challenge step. Process name only.

metrics.name: encode_check_first
metrics.description: Loop must check encoder facts before narrative synthesis.

metrics.name: halt_required
metrics.description: Halt reason must be typed and present.

leakage_rules.rule: Future candles present in the fixture remain hidden at as_of. Features, encoder memory, and loop traces at T must not change when post-T candles are perturbed.
A 5m observation must not silently overwrite 4h/1h regime state.
Once an invalidation condition is met, the thesis is closed or changed. Agents may not retroactively move invalidation levels.
The benchmark demands point-in-time state discipline, not a hindsight-perfect trade call. Do not add fabricated forecast outcomes to satisfy this gate.

validation_policy.note: Replay the fixture chronologically at each as_of. Random shuffle is prohibited. Do not score this pointer as if a walk-forward forecast run had been executed.

pass_fail_rules.rule: Replay must satisfy the expected_invariants.json already stored under the RLH fixture. This registry entry does not replace or rewrite those invariants.
A change that adds invented prices, forecast scores, or post-hoc thesis edits to make the episode look predicted fails this gate.
Registry work must only point at benchmarks/rlh/avax-2026-09-failed-8/. It must not modify that tree.
Promotion out of draft requires Watcher approval. Out-of-sample here means a fixture replay from a recorded commit, not a reshuffled or post-edited narrative.

notes: Constitution §18 and wiki/Home.md declare this episode permanent. The RLH fixture is still a stub (manifest status=stub). This draft is a pointer so forecast work cannot drop or redefine the founding regression. Exact prices come from the benchmark data dump when it exists, not from this file.
